items.title: Trust, not volume: The real AI advantage in game development
items.summary: Key findings from the Perforce 2026 State of Real-Time Workflows Report, produced with AWS and based on 608 practitioners. With 69 percent now using generative AI, the real advantage is trust and governance, not sheer volume. Version control and hybrid cloud are becoming the backbone of AI-era game development pipelines.
items.creator: Dyan Williams
